description: Stablecoin market cap (circulating USD), 1/7/30-day circulating change (mint/burn proxy), peg price and depeg % from DefiLlama. Pass symbols (e.g. USDT,USDC) or leave empty for the 10 largest. Net change is a change in circulating supply, not separate mint and burn events. Usually answers in about 8 s, up to 15 s on slower calls; allow a 30 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_defillama_yields when you need DeFi pool APY, TVL, 7/30-day APY change; crypto_defillama_tvl_oracle when you need Current total value locked of one DeFi protocol. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

symbols.description: Comma-separated stablecoin tickers, up to 10 (default: 10 largest)
